issue_title: Deploy hosted TukiWatch API on Railway

milestones.name: M1: Redis-Backed Rate Limiter
milestones.description: Implement Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter with in-memory fallback

milestones.name: M2: Railway Deployment & Config
milestones.description: Verify Railway config and add any missing deployment pieces

milestones.name: M3: Documentation & Polish
milestones.description: Update docs for hosted endpoint connection and verify quality gates

tasks.title: Create RedisRateLimiter class with sliding window algorithm
tasks.description: Implement Redis-backed rate limiter using sorted sets (ZSET) with Lua script for atomic check-and-increment. Key pattern: ratelimit:{ip}:{endpoint}. TTL auto-expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given Redis is available, When checking rate limit, Then uses ZSET with atomic Lua script
Given request within limit, Then returns (allowed=True, retry_after=0, remaining=N)
Given request exceeds limit, Then returns (allowed=False, retry_after=seconds, remaining=0)
Given Redis error, Then raises exception for fallback handling

tasks.title: Create InMemoryRateLimiter class (extract from existing middleware)
tasks.description: Extract the existing in-memory sliding window logic from CustomRateLimitMiddleware into a reusable InMemoryRateLimiter class with same interface as RedisRateLimiter.
acceptance_criteria: Given InMemoryRateLimiter, When checking rate limit, Then uses dict with timestamp tuples
Given same interface as RedisRateLimiter, Then can be swapped transparently
Given cleanup interval, Then removes expired entries periodically

tasks.title: Create RateLimiterFactory for backend selection
tasks.description: Factory that selects RedisRateLimiter when REDIS_URL is configured and Redis is reachable, otherwise falls back to InMemoryRateLimiter. Handles connection verification at startup.
acceptance_criteria: Given REDIS_URL set and Redis reachable, Then returns RedisRateLimiter instance
Given REDIS_URL not set, Then returns InMemoryRateLimiter instance
Given REDIS_URL set but Redis unreachable, Then logs warning and returns InMemoryRateLimiter
Given factory created, Then exposes .backend_type property ('redis' or 'memory')

tasks.title: Refactor CustomRateLimitMiddleware to use RateLimiterFactory
tasks.description: Update middleware to delegate rate limiting to the factory-provided limiter instance. Preserve all existing behavior: IP extraction, endpoint matching, response headers, 429 error format.
acceptance_criteria: Given middleware with Redis backend, Then rate limits shared across Railway replicas
Given middleware with memory backend, Then works identically to current behavior
Given rate limit exceeded, Then returns 429 with Retry-After header and JSON error
Given successful request, Then adds X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers
Given /rate-limit/stats endpoint, Then shows backend_type and redis_connected

tasks.title: Verify nixpacks.toml for Railway deployment
tasks.description: Confirm nixpacks.toml correctly installs dependencies and starts the app. Check that redis-py is in requirements.txt (already present).
acceptance_criteria: Given nixpacks.toml, Then Railway builds successfully
Given requirements.txt, Then redis>=8.1.0 is included
Given start command, Then gunicorn starts with correct workers

tasks.title: Add railway.json for explicit Railway configuration (optional)
tasks.description: Create railway.json to explicitly configure build/start if nixpacks detection has issues. Includes healthcheck path and restart policy.
acceptance_criteria: Given railway.json, Then Railway uses explicit config over auto-detection
Given healthcheck, Then /health endpoint used for liveness
Given restart policy, Then on-failure restart configured

tasks.title: Update SELF_HOSTING.md with hosted endpoint connection guide
tasks.description: Add section to SELF_HOSTING.md documenting how users connect the mobile app to the hosted Railway endpoint (QR code, deep link, build-time default). Include example Railway URL.
acceptance_criteria: Given docs/SELF_HOSTING.md, Then has 'Hosted on Railway' section
Given section, Then shows QR code generation for hosted URL
Given section, Then explains tukiwatch://connect URI format
Given section, Then mentions EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL for build-time default

tasks.title: Run quality gates (ruff, pytest) and verify all tests pass
tasks.description: Execute full quality gate pipeline in api/ directory. Fix any lint or test failures introduced by changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given uv sync --all-groups, Then dependencies install
Given uv run ruff check ., Then no lint errors
Given uv run pytest, Then all tests pass
Given manual test, Then rate limiting works with and without Redis

clarifications.question: Should the hosted Railway endpoint URL be documented in SPEC.md or only in SELF_HOSTING.md?
clarifications.answer: Document in SELF_HOSTING.md only; SPEC.md stays generic

clarifications.question: Do we need a separate railway.json or is nixpacks.toml sufficient?
clarifications.answer: nixpacks.toml is sufficient; railway.json optional for explicit config
